name: queenswood
description: Queenswood frontend workspace root. Pairs with the Polylith Clojure workspace (workspace.edn) — each JS-bearing brick lives at its usual Polylith path and is hoisted as a yarn workspace member here. `clj -M:poly libs` already treats these package.json files as a first-class dependency source.
$comment: The Svelte toolchain (svelte, vite, @sveltejs/vite-plugin-svelte) is declared per workspace member, not here: yarn only exposes a binary to a workspace that declares the package shipping it, so with vite at the root alone `yarn workspace console build` cannot find it. `yarn dedupe --check` in the js CI job holds those ranges to one resolved copy each.
